title: Casual Conversations v2: Designing a large consent-driven dataset to measure algorithmic bias and robustness
benchmark_measurement: The paper describes the design of a dataset to measure algorithmic bias and robustness. It does not include religion or faith as a category for measurement.
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion; therefore, there are no findings related to it.
